args: Is there a clean, traceable link from an order to the money actually collected for it, or do orders vanish (no captured payment) or multiply (captured payments exceeding order value) along the way?

{"run": "run6", "manager": "data", "analyst": "Yuki Tanaka", "engineer": "Ines", "situation": "metric-certification", "week": 1, "night": 1, "request": 2, "grain": "calendar month, 2023-01 through 2025-12, based on order placed_at month", "columns_requested": ["month", "orders_count", "orders_grand_total_eur", "orders_with_captured_payment_count", "captured_payment_total_eur", "orders_without_captured_payment_count", "gap_eur", "gap_pct"], "details": "Scope: all tenants combined.
